lantern.name: Family Lantern
lantern.desc: The Lantern that lets Mio Shift between the Near and Far Shores.
lantern.how: Granny Sachi hands it to Mio at the village square (opening).

use.note: Q key / Shift command; also lights Lantern Posts

unlocks.note: Far path past the Near boulder

lantern.story: Sachi's heirloom; shatters at the end of Ch5 and is rebuilt as the Rekindled Lantern in Ch6.

hanzo_note.name: Ghost's Message
hanzo_note.desc: A message from the other shore, to be told aloud to Hanzo.
hanzo_note.how: A Far-Shore ghost asks Mio to carry a message (told aloud, held as a note).

unlocks.note: Quest "A Message for Hanzo"; reward Spirit Charm

hanzo_note.story: Teaches that Far-Shore ghosts carry real unfinished sentences.

wind_chime.name: Kiku's Wind-chime
wind_chime.desc: Kiku's lost wind-chime. It tinkles with Far Shore light.
wind_chime.how: Visible only on the Far Shore: found snagged in a dead tree.
wind_chime.story: First lesson in "look where only the other Shore can see". Build id is wind_chime; spec offering also uses wind_chime, so the spec key item is renamed.

shrine_key.name: Shrine Key
shrine_key.desc: The Well Spirit's gift. It opens the Bell Shrine gate.
shrine_key.how: The Well Spirit presses it into Mio's hand after she Calms it (bottom of Ashiro Well, reached from the Old Well Grounds).
shrine_key.story: Peaceful first contact: the game rewards Parley with progress.

elder_seal.name: Elder Matsu's Seal
elder_seal.desc: A red seal the village guards respect after dark.
elder_seal.how: Elder Matsu stamps a pass after the player tells him about the silent Bell.

unlocks.note: North village gate after dusk (soft: the Far path skips it)

elder_seal.story: A soft social gate that the Far Shore lets clever players bypass — teaches shifting as an alternative to keys.

shrine_bell_clapper.name: Shrine Bell Clapper
shrine_bell_clapper.desc: Hung at the shrine to ring true.
shrine_bell_clapper.how: Found in the Hollow Shrine F2 vault (Far-only chest).

unlocks.note: Ring the Bell: opens the Bell-Keeper arena
Ringing in-battle breaks the Keeper's Veil (scripted)

shrine_bell_clapper.story: Spec key item. The Bell is "silent" because its heart was taken — the clapper is that heart.

dew_lens.name: Dew Lens
dew_lens.desc: A drop of well-water in a brass ring. Look through it to see the other Shore.
dew_lens.how: Hollow Shrine F1: guarded chest on the Far side (Gloam Bat pack).

use.note: Hold for 5s; shows objects of the other realm as ghost outlines

unlocks.note: Free: shows next-turn tell on Veiled foes (1 use/battle) — proposal

dew_lens.story: Zelda-style Lens of Truth, but costs Lumen so it is a choice not a toggle.

collectors_book.name: Keeper's Ledger
collectors_book.desc: A cloth-bound ledger. Every Sent soul leaves a line.
collectors_book.how: Granny Sachi gives it after the first peaceful Send (return to Ashiro).

use.note: Bestiary + Name Fragment ledger + Bond log

unlocks.note: Unlocks Bestiary / Name Fragments / Bond screens

collectors_book.story: Collection UI as an in-world object: the game explains Name Fragments by handing you the book that stores them.

wellkeeper_pebble.name: Wellkeeper's Pebble
wellkeeper_pebble.desc: A smooth river pebble that is always damp.
wellkeeper_pebble.how: Well Spirit's thanks after the Bell-Keeper is laid to rest.
wellkeeper_pebble.story: The first Keepsake: the player learns a spirit can be asked for help, not only fought.

anchor_stone.name: Anchor Stone
anchor_stone.desc: A heavy grey stone that refuses to drift.
anchor_stone.how: Mist Heron's keeper gives it after Mio helps a lost traveller out of the Misty Grove.

use.note: Pins a "drift" tile or bridge for 30s in the Far Shore

anchor_stone.story: Teaches "holding on" — also Mio's emotional through-line.

toll_token.name: Toll Token
toll_token.desc: A worn bronze coin with a hole in it.
toll_token.how: Forgotten Pilgrim presses it on you: the pilgrim never got to pay the Kappa.

unlocks.note: Crossing toll (soft: Parley or fight the Toll-Keeper instead)

toll_token.story: A soft gate: key OR skill OR strength — three solutions to one lock.

wick_forest.name: Whisper Wick
wick_forest.desc: A lantern wick that burns without smoke. Use to raise max Lumen +10 (70).
wick_forest.how: Lit candle at the heart of Willow Hollow.
wick_forest.story: Wicks are visible progress for the Lantern; each is tied to a place.

remembrance_cord.name: Remembrance Cord
remembrance_cord.desc: A cord of knotted names. Tie it to a Hollowed person to feel their name.
remembrance_cord.how: Rustle Sprite's trade for a Flower Bundle (soft side quest).
remembrance_cord.story: Name Fragments are the game's currency of care.

oto_bell.name: Oto's Bell
oto_bell.desc: A tiny bell on a worn collar.
oto_bell.how: Return the lost dog Oto to the old woman at the Crossing shop.

use.note: Oto leads you toward the nearest unfinished objective (optional hint system)

oto_bell.story: Accessibility as story: the in-world hint system is a ghost dog.

willow_sprig.name: Willow Sprig
willow_sprig.desc: A sprig that wants to be planted.
willow_sprig.how: Willow Mother, once Calmed or Sent, leaves a green sprig.

use.note: Grows a root bridge on bare-soil tiles (Far)

willow_sprig.story: A boss reward that is also a tool: the player keeps what they Sent.

veil_sash.name: Veil Sash
veil_sash.desc: A sash that makes you look like you belong in the Night Market.
veil_sash.how: The Harbor Market doorman gives it to anyone wearing Parade colours — buy the dye from Tanuki Stall (quest).

use.note: Worn automatically; enables Slip (field spell) and Veil Rend UI

unlocks.note: Unlocks Veil Arts menu (VP mechanic tutorial)

veil_sash.story: Social gate that reuses the Veil system; the player becomes "one of them" to cross.

wick_market.name: Market Wick
wick_market.desc: A wick sold to travelers who can't afford oil. Max Lumen +10 (80).
wick_market.how: Reward of the Lantern Stall side quest.

punt_pole.name: Punt Pole
punt_pole.desc: A long pole for pushing flat boats.
punt_pole.how: Boatman at the Moonlit Canals docks, after Mio calms his drowned clerk.
punt_pole.story: Zelda lesson: a tool introduced in a tutorial room pays back later in a different biome.

charm_cord.name: Charm Cord
charm_cord.desc: A braided cord with a loop.
charm_cord.how: Night Market seamstress ("I can braid a second charm onto your sleeve").
charm_cord.story: System unlock as an item: UI changes are diegetic.

smith_tongs.name: Smith's Tongs
smith_tongs.how: Daigo hands them over when he joins ("a smith without tongs is just a big man").

use.note: Opens the forge menu at Ashiro; lets Daigo lift hot objects

unlocks.note: Handles hot valves in Cinder Mine

smith_tongs.story: Gives the party a crafting hub as a character beat.

parade_ticket.name: Parade Ticket
parade_ticket.desc: A scrap of paper marked "Admit one soul".
parade_ticket.how: Gonbei's drummer hands it out for Echo-charged Parley; or from a stall prize.
parade_ticket.story: Introduces Echo as a social mechanic.

wick_forge.name: Forge Wick
wick_forge.desc: A wick lit from the Hundred-Year Anvil. Max Lumen +10 (90).
wick_forge.how: Lit by Daigo at the Cinder Hollow forge after the Anvil is calmed.
wick_forge.story: Daigo's warmth literally lights Mio's lantern.

quench_flask.name: Quench Flask
quench_flask.desc: A flask of cold well-water that never empties on the Near side.
quench_flask.how: Cinder Mine foreman's locker (Near; unlock with Mine Key chest).

use.note: Extinguishes vents; in the Far Shore it freezes slag into walkable glass

quench_flask.story: Dual-use: the same item solves one puzzle in Near and a different puzzle in Far.

cinder_lamp.name: Cinder Lamp
cinder_lamp.desc: A hooded lamp with a foxfire inside.
cinder_lamp.how: Kitsunebi Mote leaves it after a Parley Calm (or craft at Cinder Hollow forge).
cinder_lamp.story: Opposite-pair design with Quench Flask (fire/water) — players learn when each applies.

anvil_heart.name: Anvil Heart
anvil_heart.desc: A glowing coal the size of a fist, hammered flat.
anvil_heart.how: The Hundred-Year Anvil gives its heart when Calmed or Sent.

unlocks.note: Combined with Anvil Core re-forges Ward Charm+

anvil_heart.story: The boss is a craftsman: his heart becomes a gift to Daigo.

sachi_ember.name: Sachi's Ember
sachi_ember.desc: A tiny coal that remembers her voice.
sachi_ember.how: After the scripted loss to Tsubaki, Sachi's ember is the only light left.

use.note: Used to relight the Lantern in Ch6

unlocks.note: Prevents Mio's Lumen from dropping below 20 while Fading (floor)

sachi_ember.story: The scripted loss gives a *thing* to hold, which converts defeat into progress.

lantern_shard_hearth.name: Shard of Hearth
lantern_shard_hearth.desc: A shard that smells of rice and smoke.
lantern_shard_hearth.how: Memory of Sachi's kitchen; wins the Hearth fragment after the Faded Neighbor scene.

use.note: Lantern rebuild shard 1/3; also Sachi's Keepsake

lantern_shard_hearth.story: The flashback gives the party back its guardian.

lantern_shard_name.name: Shard of Names
lantern_shard_name.desc: A shard covered in names that tire the eye.
lantern_shard_name.how: Archive Echo gives it once the Echo is Calmed or Sent.
lantern_shard_name.story: Names = the villain's theme and the hero's gift.

lantern_shard_forge.name: Shard of the Forge
lantern_shard_forge.how: Daigo went back to the cold Anvil and brings the warm shard to Ashiro.
lantern_shard_forge.story: Each shard belongs to one party member's history.

full_lantern.name: Rekindled Lantern
full_lantern.desc: The Family Lantern, mended with ember and shards. It burns with both lights.
full_lantern.how: Rebuilt at Ashiro forge from the three shards + Sachi's Ember.
full_lantern.story: Item replacement as upgrade: players feel the Lantern grow.

archive_page_item.name: Archive Page
archive_page_item.how: Dropped by the Archive Echo; shows Kaze's name crossed out.
archive_page_item.story: Key that is also the emotional hook: the door asks you to hand over a friend's name.

marigold_garland.name: Marigold Garland
marigold_garland.desc: A garland of fresh marigolds, glowing orange.
marigold_garland.how: Alebrije Pup guides Mio to a marigold field; weave a garland for the Stair keeper.
marigold_garland.story: Optional tower gated by a soft story token.

thaw_candle.name: Thaw Candle
thaw_candle.desc: A candle that burns warm even when it is cold.
thaw_candle.how: Stone Peony gives it when Calmed; nobody remembers why peonies hold candles.

use.note: Wakes Stilled statues; in battle: removes Stilled from one ally (1/battle)

thaw_candle.story: The Garden's villain is an *idea* (stillness): the tool is warmth.

guardian_pebble.name: Guardian's Pebble
guardian_pebble.desc: A pebble from the base of the Guardian.
guardian_pebble.how: Garden Guardian's gift once Calmed (or Sent).
guardian_pebble.story: A boss that guards, not attacks: the reward is protective.

readers_card.name: Reader's Card
readers_card.desc: A card granting entry to the Archive Index.
readers_card.how: Garden Guardian's keeper stamps it when Mio returns the Stone Peony's petal.
readers_card.story: Hand the player a library card — a literal reading permission.

ancestor_comb.name: Ancestor's Comb
ancestor_comb.desc: A comb with a tooth missing.
ancestor_comb.how: Hidden shelf in the Archive Stacks (needs Dew Lens).

use.note: Reveals Tsubaki's past in a cutscene; required for the true ending

unlocks.note: Unlocks the "Name" Parley verb against Tsubaki

ancestor_comb.story: Reward for using a tool from Ch2; optional but emotionally decisive.

procession_lantern.name: Procession Lantern
procession_lantern.desc: A small paper lantern that glows with many names.
procession_lantern.how: Archive Heart: lit by Mio once Name Fragments >= 18.
procession_lantern.story: Collection payoff: Name Fragments become light.

kaze_name_scrap.name: Kaze's Name Scrap
kaze_name_scrap.how: Archive Echo's final page after Kaze's name is spoken.

unlocks.note: Kaze's Unison gets +20% power vs Tsubaki

lantern_night_charm.name: Lantern Night Charm
lantern_night_charm.how: Granny Sachi gives it at the end of Lantern Night.

use.note: Ending token; carried into New Game+

ks_amabie.name: Amabie's Scale Locket
ks_amabie.desc: A prophet's scale; hold it to call her Foretelling.
ks_amabie.how: A bonded spirit gives it at high Bond.

ks_kettle.name: Brownie's Ladle
ks_kettle.desc: A tiny wooden ladle that smells of soup.
ks_kettle.how: A bonded spirit gives it at high Bond.

ks_tengu.name: Tengu's Small Fan
ks_tengu.desc: A pocket fan; a flick starts a gale.
ks_tengu.how: A bonded spirit gives it at high Bond.

lantern_shard.name: Lantern Shard
lantern_shard.desc: A piece of the shattered Lantern. Five pieces are needed.
lantern_shard.how: Cinder Hollow after the shattering (1 of 5), then the Memory Trail (4 more).

L01.desc: Shift to the Far Shore — the whole game depends on it.

L02.desc: North village gate guards turn you back after dusk.
alternatives: Take the Far-Shore path past the gate (no seal needed)
L02.reward: Shortcut to the Old Well Grounds

L03.desc: A boulder blocks the way into the Well in the Near; the Far path is clear.

L07.desc: Ring the Bell at the Shrine top: opens the Keeper's arena.

L08.desc: Hidden Far-only alcove with Hearty Plum + Moth Charm chest.
alternatives: Find by walking every wall in Far

L10.desc: Far-Shore bridge at the Crossing drifts; anchor it long enough to cross.

L11.desc: The Kappa Toll-Keeper asks for payment.

L14.desc: Plant the sprig on bare soil to grow a root bridge into the inner glade.

L15.desc: Oto marks hidden paths with a bark.

L16.desc: The Night Market doorman only admits "someone who belongs".
alternatives: Buy a ticket from a stall (60g) — soft alternative

L17.desc: Canal crossing requires poling a flat boat.

L22.desc: Hot valve vents: douse with Quench Flask; turn valves with Smith's Tongs.

L24.desc: Far-Shore slag river: freeze into glass bridge.

L26.desc: Rebuild the Lantern at the Ashiro forge.

L27.desc: Sachi's home in Fading Ashiro responds to the ember.

L28.desc: Flooded passage on the Memory Trail (reuse of canals tool).

alternatives: Challenge the keeper in a Parley

L30.desc: Archive Index door asks for a name (the page is carried from Ch6: a two-chapter foreshadow).

L32.desc: Stilled statues block corridors in the Garden (z18, z19).

L33.desc: Sealed shelf outlines visible only through the Dew Lens (Archive Stacks).

L34.desc: Archive Heart door opens only to the Rekindled Lantern.

L39.desc: Thorn hedge in the Still Garden.

L40.desc: Archive Veil Attendants only let veiled visitors pass.
